verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no pre-meeting prep feature. Nothing shows Fireflies automatically surfacing past meetings with the same attendees, or generating a brief of open threads before an upcoming call. What exists is adjacent only: an API filter for transcripts by attendee email, which is a developer building block, and AskFred, which answers questions about past meetings when the user asks. Neither is proactive, calendar-triggered pre-call prep.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call
